name: Kailua Kupulau 2025
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png) ### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with another WCA competition, this time on the Windward Side! * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. * If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 1:00 PM. --- #### This competition will take place over the course of two days! Please note that this competition will span more than one day. You are not required to attend both days of the competition if you are only competing in one day. **Saturday Events:** 3x3, 2x2, 4x4, Pyraminx, Skewb **Sunday Events:** 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 MultiBlind --- #### This competition will also be part of [WCC Western FMC Championship 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2025)! For more information, please visit the [Fewest Moves tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaKupulau2025#56089-fewest-moves).
